text:
Bo Horvat is having the season his chances said he'd have last year. The Islanders captain has 9 goals on 9.1 expected goals, which is exactly as many as his shots earned. Last season Evolving-Hockey had him at 2.0 expected wins against 0.9 actual: the chances came, the goals didn't. This year they're arriving on time.

He has 20 points in 19 games and a four-game point streak, playing 21:10 a night against the other team's best (99th percentile competition last season). The Islanders take 53.8% of the expected goals at five on five with him on, though they've also scored 4.2 more goals than expected in those minutes, so the team around him is running a little lucky.

His game is transition. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had 59% of his shots coming off the rush and 62% of his entries as carries. The thing to watch this week is health: Stefen Rosner of NHL.com noted he didn't play the final 4:17 in Anaheim, then posted that Horvat was on the ice for practice Monday. Our numbers have him around 39 goals by season's end if he stays in the lineup.
headline: Horvat's chances are back, and so is the captain
